job.beschreibung:
Our Lab Transformation practice brings together scientific innovation and advanced digital technologies to modernize laboratory operations. We partner with clients to co-create digitally enabled labs that transform scientific processes and outcomes. Our team combines scientific and lab informatics expertise with strategic consulting and industry platform knowledge, delivering innovative solutions at global scale across industries.
We leverage automation, AI, IoT, analytics, and cloud technologies—alongside a redesigned scientific user experience—to help clients better capture, integrate, and analyze complex data. The result: faster discovery and product development, improved quality and compliance, reduced time to market, and greater operational efficiency.
As a member of the Lab Transformation team, you will work with cutting-edge technologies and leading organizations across industry and government.
What would you do?
Apply management consulting and design-thinking techniques as you work on the fundamental redesign of the scientific user experience
Help shape client’s transformation vision, focus areas, and journey from the current state to a “to-be” enterprise environment
Redesign processes and operating models to enable new ways of working with data-driven business cases
Provide point-of-view on laboratory and scientific informatics solutions to deliver on transformational goals along with strengths and weaknesses of various technology solutions.
Create digital laboratory thought leadership for clients across Life Sciences.
Collaborate with client leaders to ensure buy-in to recommended solutions.
Oversee, design, and implement digital solutions such as Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Laboratory Notebooks (ELN), Chromatography Data Systems (CDS), Scientific Data Management Systems (SDMS), artificial intelligence including GenAI, Internet of Things (IoT), and cloud
Help clients better capture, handle, integrate and analyze complex scientific data
Experience in a consulting environment
Demonstrated expertise in Lab Informatics
Demostrated experience in transformation
Willingness to travel up to 50% to client locations
Location: across Europe

About Accenture

Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
